BarScheduleColumn.description:
A column of the schedule: ``key`` (member, mark, size, shape, a letter, members,
per_member, total_count, cutting_length, total_length, mass, remarks) and its title; the
title's ``{len}`` is the display unit of lengths (mm).
BarScheduleColumn.title: BarScheduleColumn

name.description: The standard as the notes name it (e.g. 'BS 8666').
name.title: Name

shapeTerm.description: What it calls its shape codes.
shapeTerm.title: Shapeterm

radius.description: The standard's minimum scheduling radius; the bend radius is the larger of it and half the code's least bend diameter (None: the code's alone).

endProjection.description: Minimum end projection P (None: not checked).

linkHook.description: The outside dimension of a link's hooked end (expression in ext, r, d).
linkHook.title: Linkhook

deductions.description: Bend deductions by angle ('45', '90', '135', '180') × d: b45, b90, ... in the formulas.
deductions.title: Deductions

sizeLabel.description: A bar size as printed ({d}: its size).
sizeLabel.title: Sizelabel

aliases.description: Shape names of the detailing model -> shape code.
aliases.title: Aliases

special.description: The code of a special (as sketched) bar.
special.title: Special

note.description: The schedule's note: {name}, {bend} (the code's bend clause), {round} and {unit} are filled in.
note.title: Note

BarShape.description: A shape code: its dimension letters and its cutting length.

name.description: What the shape is (straight, L bar, closed link, ...).
name.title: Name

letters.description: The dimension letters scheduled, in order.
letters.title: Letters

length.description: Cutting length: an expression in the letters, d, r, ext, pi, the standard's deductions (b45, b90, b135, b180) and max, min, sqrt, ceil.
length.title: Length

defaults.description: Letters that may be left out -> expression of them.
defaults.title: Defaults

endCheck.description: Check the first and last letters against the end projection.
endCheck.title: Endcheck

hook.description: Letter the schedule fills with the link hook when not given.
hook.title: Hook

radius.description: Letter of a scheduled bend radius (noted if low).
radius.title: Radius

counts.description: Letters that are counts, not mm (turns).
counts.title: Counts

remarks.description: Remark printed with the bar (e.g. 'C = turns').
remarks.title: Remarks

kind.description: straight: a bar with only a length is scheduled as A; special: as detailed.
kind.title: Kind

bvbs.description: The shape as BVBS geometry: in order, the legs ('l', outside length), the arcs ('r', inside radius) and the bend angles after them ('w', degrees, one sign for one bending direction; the last 'w' is 0), each an expression in the letters, d and r. None: the bar is sent without its geometry (the machine operator enters it).
bvbs.title: Bvbs

BarShape.title: BarShape

EndProjection.description:
The standard's minimum straight end projection P [mm]: ``bySize``, else r + ``radiusDb``
× d rounded up to ``roundTo``.

radiusDb.description: P = r + this × d for other sizes.
radiusDb.title: Radiusdb

EndProjection.title: EndProjection

MinimumRadius.description:
The standard's minimum scheduling radius r [mm]: ``bySize`` (bar size [mm] as text ->
r), else the first of ``steps`` that holds the bar.
MinimumRadius.title: MinimumRadius

RadiusStep.description:
Bars up to ``upTo`` [mm] (None: every larger bar): a radius of ``factor`` × d, rounded up
to a whole millimetre when ``ceil``.

upTo.description: Bar size up to [mm]; None: above.
upTo.title: Upto

factor.description: Minimum radius as a multiple of d.
factor.title: Factor

ceil.description: Round the radius up to a whole mm.
ceil.title: Ceil

RadiusStep.title: RadiusStep

ShapeSketch.description:
A shape's sketch for the drawing set's shape key: polylines in a box of about 1 × 1
(``paths``, each a list of (x, y)), and where each dimension letter is written.

labels.description: Dimension letter -> (x, y) of its label.
labels.title: Labels

ShapeSketch.title: ShapeSketch

description:
The bar bending schedule's standard (:mod:`saengine.drawings.bbs`): ``standard`` picks
one of ``standards`` (or of a built-in pack's); ``shapeKey`` draws the sketches of the shape
codes used on the schedule's sheets.

source.description: Clause (and page) the table comes from.
source.title: Source

sources.description: Clause references of single entries: {key: clause}.
sources.title: Sources

clauses.description: Short clause references the results cite, by key, without the code's name (e.g. 'Part 6 Sec 2.5.7.3'); read by saengine.codes.context.cite. A key the pack does not give is not cited.
clauses.title: Clauses

standard.description: The standard the schedules follow (a key of standards).
standard.title: Standard

shapeKey.description: Draw the shape key (sketches) on the schedule's sheets.
shapeKey.title: Shapekey

standards.description: The standards this pack gives, by id.
standards.title: Standards

title: BarScheduleTable
